Downloading Documents Before Signing in Blueink: A Step-by-Step Guide

This article will guide you through the process of downloading documents in Blueink before you add your signature.

Written by Sophia Rose
October 17, 2025
Introduction:

At times, you may need to download and review a document in Blueink before signing it. This article will guide you through the process of downloading documents in Blueink before you add your signature.

 

How to Download Documents Before Signing in Blueink:

Open the document that was sent to you and click "Review and Sign."

 

Once the document opens, click "Continue."

 

Look for the "Actions" button located in the top right corner of the screen.

 

Click on the "Actions" button, and a menu will appear with the option to download the document in PDF format.

 

Click on the "Download" option, and the file will be downloaded to your device.

 

Once the file is downloaded, you can open it and review it before signing. If needed, you can also print the document for your records.

 

Conclusion:

By following these steps, you can easily download documents in Blueink before signing them. This allows you to thoroughly review the document and ensure that you understand its contents before adding your signature. If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to reach out for help.
